title: Pancreatic Insulin Content by Acid-Ethanol Extraction
author: Ed Leiter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3jjgkkn
materials: Homogenize tissue (I use a Polytron homogenizer).
Divide Insulin content ng/ml by Protein content µg/ml.

steps.title: Prepare Pancreas Sample
steps.instruction: Place 1/4 - 1/2 of the pancreas into 5 ml Acid-Ethanol (1.5% HCl in 70% EtOH) within a 15 ml conical vial.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Collect Extract
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 2000 rpm for 15 min at 4ºC using a Sorvall RT6000, then transfer the aqueous solution to a new 15 ml conical vial.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2000 rpm for 15 min at 4ºC
Transfer aqueous solution to a new 15 ml conical vial

steps.title: Neutralize Extract
steps.instruction: Neutralize 100 µl of the Acid-Ethanol extract by adding 100 µl of 1M Tris pH 7.5.

steps.title: Perform Insulin ELISA
steps.instruction: Dilute the neutralized extract in Insulin ELISA sample diluent and run on an Exocell Insulin ELISA.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the sample (1:100, 1:1000, or 1:5000 depending upon the strain)
Run diluted sample on Insulin ELISA (Exocell)
Calculate ng/ml using the appropriate dilution factor

steps.title: Perform Bradford Assay
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration of the neutralized solution using a Bradford Assay.

substeps.instruction: Run 20 µl of the neutralized solution with 250 µl Coomassie Blue Reagent (Thermo Scientific) against a standard curve
Calculate µg/ml using the appropriate dilution factor
